item.title: Providence considering sale of health plan
item.description: The Catholic nonprofit continues to search for new ways to cut costs, including a potential sale of Providence Health Plan, the company disclosed Thursday.

item.title: Hospitals’ financial performance off to a shaky start in 2026: report
item.description: Rising bad debt and expenses challenged hospitals in January — and those pressures aren’t likely to abate, according to consultancy Kaufman Hall.

item.title: The post-acute blind spot: Why what happens after discharge matters more than ever
item.description: Post-acute care is healthcare’s biggest blind spot — and a major opportunity.

item.title: Beyond the hype: Agentic AI takes center stage at HIMSS 2026
item.description: Agentic AI transforms healthcare through autonomous agents handling scheduling, documentation and coding at HIMSS 2026.

item.title: Digital twins for spend are changing how finance teams monitor and optimize performance
item.description: Utilizing AI to structure all contract and invoice data, healthcare leaders are creating digital twins for spend to create a permanent advantage.

item.title: FTC creates healthcare task force
item.description: The task force will share resources and coordinate enforcement across the Federal Trade Commission’s disparate bureaus to better address consumer protection and competition issues in healthcare.

item.title: 1 in 10 ACA enrollees dropped coverage after subsidy lapse: poll
item.description: More than half of respondents said their healthcare expenses are “a lot higher” this year, according to the KFF survey. One in 10 reported dropping coverage and becoming uninsured.

item.title: CMS sets standards for electronic transfer of claims documentation
item.description: The rule standardizes the electronic exchange of medical records and other documents requested by payers to support claims. It should cut out outdated methods like faxes and snail mail, the CMS said.

item.title: Cencora to buy EyeSouth’s retina business for $1.1B
item.description: The proposed acquisition is Cencora’s latest push into retina services as the company looks to expand its specialty support business. Cencora doesn't expect the deal to close before the end of September.

item.title: CommonSpirit, Humana reach new nationwide Medicare Advantage contract
item.description: The new agreement will give Humana’s MA members access to CommonSpirit’s doctors and facilities for the next three years, and returns CommonSpirit to Humana’s networks in Colorado and Texas.
